assign.brief: Make session accounting and past-work retrieval actually work; answer the voice agent's questions in a sentence or two each.

log.msg: A: Servex DOES capture per-turn usage, but outside the repo. Agent.result() (Servex/agents/Agents.js ~1695-1740) emits {type:result, turn_cost, cost, usage{input,cache_read,cache_creation,output}} to %LOCALAPPDATA%/lew42/servex/logs/agent-<id>.jsonl; 275 of 3017 agent logs carry turn_cost. Nothing goes into the session task.jsonl. turn_cost = delta of SDK total_cost_usd (Anthropic-table guess); OpenRouter agents priced by refresh_or_cost(). Usage summed per turn: no per-API-call or tool/thinking split. VS Code/CLI sessions: no live capture at all.

A caveat: round4-result.md sec 2: registry cost over-counts 2.85x-16x with turn count; AISession snapshot over-counts replayed transcripts (RING=40); 5-5 price table ASSUMED. Only AISessionDigest and AISessionAudit (dedupe every message id) agree (571/571).

B proposal: one counter (AISessionDigest, already exact per message id) run two ways: live from Agent.result() appending a usage line into the session folder, and retroactively over ~/.claude/projects transcripts; the spend-tree roll-up reads those lines instead of hand-run spend-tree.json (stale since 2026-10-04 19:11).

C: module lookup works for TASKS: Server/SessionIndex.mjs query({module}) smoke-tested, ux/Dictate = 43 tasks. Sessions: 587 digest.json files (round 4) carry edited files + mod/ tags, but SessionIndex does not read digests yet, and 41% of task logs name no files (query.md sec 9). Verdict: partial.
